entities.name: Talruum Mountains
entities.description: Inhospitable mountains between Suq'Ata and the Mwonvuli Jungle, home of fierce minotaurs.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Skyship that crash-landed in Talruum and later returned seeking recruits.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Minotaur who dueled for the Weatherlight crew and joined it.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased out much of northwestern Jamuraa.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Person who destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

entities.name: Wrenn and Realmbreaker
entities.description: Returned the phased-out Zhalfir to the multiverse.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion of Dominaria that Teferi phased out lands to protect against.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Later Phyrexian invasion after which Zhalfir was returned.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Plane where the phased-out Talruum portions now exist.

events.summary: The Weatherlight crash-landed in Talruum after a nesting dragon damaged it.
events.quote: the Skyship Weatherlight was forced to crash land in Talruum after being damaged by a nesting dragon

events.summary: Tahngarth won a duel on behalf of the crew and joined the Weatherlight crew.
events.quote: Tahngarth then joined the crew and the hunt for the Legacy

events.summary: Teferi phased out much of the Talruum Mountains to protect them from the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Much of the Talruum Mountains were phased out by Teferi

events.summary: The Weatherlight found only blue skies and seas where Talruum had been.
events.quote: they found only blue skies and blue seas

events.summary: Jeska destroyed the time rift, losing the phased-out portions from Dominaria.
events.quote: The phased-out portions were forever lost from Dominaria when Jeska destroyed the time rift

events.summary: Wrenn and Realmbreaker returned Zhalfir to the multiverse by swapping it with New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Wrenn and Realmbreaker returned the phased out Zhalfir to the multiverse

relations.quote: Tahngarth then joined the crew and the hunt for the Legacy
